about: measure contests of 2016 in Colorado, in the layout of plan/PLAN.md section 3 with the fields data/README.md adds (D3). Built by pipeline/local_medsl.py from pipeline/intake/medsl_precinct.py's cache.

model.name: the model's own forecast, method D3-v1.1
